mapper.select: select * ,FORMAT(wdate, 'yyyy-MM-dd') AS formatted_date from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_NEWS where num = #{num}

select TOP 1 a.*,FORMAT(a.wdate, 'yyyy.MM.dd') AS formatted_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_NEWS_TAIL b WHERE b.info_num = a.num) AS tail_count from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_NEWS a where 1=1 and a.part = #{part} and a.num < #{num} and a.flag = 'N' ORDER BY a.num DESC

select TOP 1 a.*,FORMAT(a.wdate, 'yyyy.MM.dd') AS formatted_date, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_NEWS_TAIL b WHERE b.info_num = a.num) AS tail_count from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_NEWS a where 1=1 and a.part = #{part} and a.num > #{num} and a.flag = 'N' ORDER BY a.num

SELECT * FROM ( select *,FORMAT(wdate , 'yyyy.MM.dd') AS formatted_date, FORMAT(wdate, 'HH:mm') AS formatted_time, KCC_EGIS.egis.FN_MASK_ID(id) as id2, KCC_EGIS.egis.FN_MASK_NAME(writer) writer2 from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_NEWS_TAIL where info_num = #{info_num} ) A ORDER BY num

select top 4 a.*,FORMAT(a.wdate, 'yyyy.MM.dd') AS formatted_date ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_NEWS_TAIL b WHERE b.info_num = a.num) AS tail_count from KCC_EGIS.egis.TBL_NEWS a where a.part = 'notice' and a.flag = 'N' order by a.num desc
